title: TFam's Backrooms Essentials
description: A Minecraft mod that adds several Backrooms blocks to use in your own worlds.
body:
Inspired by Kane Pixels, this Minecraft mod adds several Backrooms blocks to use in your own worlds! Many items are available for your use to add extra detail at the highest quality. Currently will only work for NeoForge 1.21.8 

This mod adds:
- Several different wallpapers
- Liminal props
- Ceiling and light tiles
- Noclippable block variants
- More!


NOTE: THIS MOD DOES NOT ADD ENTITIES OR A BACKROOMS DIMENSION. IT IS ONLY FOR YOU TO BUILD YOUR OWN MAPS.
